sources.title: Liner.ai - Machine Learning without Code
sources.snippet: Liner is an end-to-end tool for training machine learning models without code. It uses your training data and gives a model which can be integrated with your application.

sources.title: Liner AI No-Code Machine Learning Platform - pickaitool.com
sources.snippet: Liner AI is a free no-code machine learning tool designed to simplify AI model creation for beginners, developers, educators, and businesses. The platform allows users to import datasets, train machine learning models, and deploy them without writing code.

sources.title: Liner.ai - AI Model Builder Tool - topai.tools
sources.snippet: Build and train AI models locally without coding, preserving privacy. Liner.ai is a Free AI Model Builder tool. See pricing plans, key features and use.
